visible_evidence: English translation of Arabic-bearing conversation turns or unchanged English turns
ordinary_baselines.translation_output_reuse: Generate once per locked Arabic-bearing input and reuse the exact hash-bound output across all three judge backbones where feasible.

visible_evidence: same complete original pre-action conversation as direct baseline
ordinary_baselines.aggregation: invalid if tool contract or any relevant constraint is violated; otherwise valid; contradictory or malformed combinations are invalid_output
valid only if all three parse valid; invalid if all parse and one or more are invalid; otherwise unscored

run_configuration_proposal.prompt_bundle_version: versioned per baseline; exact wording unapproved
run_configuration_proposal.secrets: Never store credentials in manifests, source, or logs.

state_extraction.input: ordinary conversation, action, and public tool contract only
state_extraction.output: model-generated active-constraint fields with source turn indices
state_extraction.scoring: separate blinded scorer compares observable extraction fields with canonical reference fields after inference

oracle_state_intervention.input: ordinary evidence plus effective state only
oracle_state_intervention.analysis: paired correctness change against ordinary direct judgment, reported separately

state_reconstruction_diagnostic_proposal.interpretation: Observable extracted-state agreement is not proof of internal model reasoning.

competence_screen_proposal.materials: independently authored English and MSA items disjoint from all study wording, scenarios, states, labels, and reference data
competence_screen_proposal.use: Provisional pass/fail competence screen only; not a benchmark outcome or model ranking. Do not run or select models from outcomes without approval.

token_assumptions.note: Planning averages, not measured study token lengths. Visible tokens are common request-class approximations; provider-specific reasoning-token output estimates are added to billed output. No study examples or provider tokenizers were inspected.

budget_proposal.retry_stress: 0%, 2%, and 10% of applicable calls receive one extra technical attempt; expected/high products are expected counts and can be fractional. No retries assumed for malformed/refused outputs. No caching or batch discounts.
budget_proposal.translation_quality: The total assumes 24 optional independent translation-QC inputs in addition to 288 locked Arabic-bearing inputs; remove these costs if owner declines that separate QC plan.
excluded_costs: price or model changes after checked date
budget_proposal.authorization: Planning only. No expenditure, API call, or study-data transmission is authorized. Reprice and recompute before any budget request.
